{ "entries": [ { "name_han": "太上洞玄靈寶中和經", "logic_thesis": "The Zhonghe Jing proves that cosmic order and personal destiny are governed by the same mid-point equilibrium (中和): when yin-yang, qi, and intent neither excess nor deficiency, the Dao manifests as fortune; imbalance is not fate’s cruelty but a measurable deviation from the mean. Therefore moral cultivation and BaZi reading converge on one criterion—return to the neutral balance that generates life.", "logic_chain": "1) Heaven and Earth endure because they hold the middle between extremes. 2) Human qi, emotions, and fortune are the same continuum as celestial qi. 3) Excess/deficiency of any phase or passion therefore equals cosmic disorder localized in the person. 4) If disorder is local imbalance, remedy is restoration of 中和, not petition to an external deity. 5) Hence longevity, peace, and correct BaZi adjustment all reduce to re-centering yin-yang and five-phase proportions. 6) Conclusion: Zhonghe is both ontology and diagnostic standard.", "logic_practice": "1) In a chart, mark which stems/branches overshoot or starve relative to the season and day-master; treat that as the primary 不中和. 2) Prefer remedies that restore mid-strength of the day-master over pure “useful god” aggression. 3) In cultivation, daily check body–breath–intent for heat, cold, agitation, lethargy; correct toward evenness before advancing techniques. 4) Ethical rule: speech and action that push any phase to extremes are treated as chart-worsening causes. 5) Timing: choose years/months that fill the deficient side rather than pile onto the strong.", "logic_compare": "Unlike pure Lingbao salvation scriptures that stress ritual merit and heavenly bureaucracy, Zhonghe Jing locates salvation in measurable balance of qi and conduct. It is closer to Zhongyong ethics than to pure liturgical Duren texts, and unlike Yinfu’s strategic stealth of Heaven, it makes the mean itself the open law of fortune." } ] }{
  "entries": [
    {
      "name_han": "太上洞玄靈寶中和經",
      "logic_thesis": "The scripture proves that fortune and misfortune are not arbitrary divine rewards but mechanical outcomes of whether persons, families, and polities hold the mid-point (中和) between excess and deficiency. Because the Dao’s own virtue is mid-balance, any local 不和 automatically generates reciprocal 相剋; therefore moral self-regulation is itself the highest salvific technology.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Dao’s operative virtue is 中和; disharmony is defined as mutual conquest. 2) Heaven–Earth, state, and household are isomorphic fields of the same law. 3) Therefore illness, war, and household ruin are localizations of cosmic imbalance, not random fate. 4) Remediation cannot be bought by wealth or sacrifice; only re-centering conduct restores true qi and expels deviant qi. 5) Hence precept-keeping is not piety theater but causal engineering of fortune. 6) Conclusion: salvation = measured return to the mean.",
      "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi, treat day-master strength and five-phase proportions as a 中和 meter; prioritize filling deficiency over stacking the already strong. 2) Score chart luck periods by whether they restore mid-balance rather than by raw ‘wealth/officer’ labels. 3) Daily cultivation: detect heat/cold, anger/lethargy as phase excess and correct before advancing technique. 4) Precepts against lust, rage, greed function as phase-stabilizers, not mere morals. 5) Timing: choose years/months that neutralize extremes, not those that amplify power.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike Duren-style scriptures that stress celestial bureaucracy and ritual merit, Zhonghe locates causality inside measurable balance of qi and conduct. It is closer to Confucian Zhongyong ethics than to pure Lingbao liturgy, and unlike Yinfu’s stealth ‘theft of Heaven,’ it makes the open mean itself the law of fortune."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "太上妙法本相經",
      "logic_thesis": "The Benxiang Jing proves that ‘naturalness’ (自然) is not blank spontaneity but the mature fruit of causal conditioning (因緣): different Dao-natures emit different qi, and different qi solidify into different forms. Therefore destiny patterns and agricultural/cosmic yields obey the same seed–fruit logic; to change a result one must change the prior causal seed, not merely wish for another fruit.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Dao differentiates; differentiation is mediated by qi. 2) Qi type determines material and mental nature (道性→物性). 3) What appears as ‘natural outcome’ is therefore the ripened form of prior causes. 4) If fruit follows seed, moral, ritual, and technical causes are not optional décor but ontological inputs. 5) Hence false paths and true paths can be discriminated by their seed-structure, not by temporary worldly success. 6) Conclusion: cultivation and fate-work are agriculture of causes.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Read a BaZi chart as a seed-field: natal stems/branches are initial conditions, luck cycles are seasonal weather. 2) Do not expect a weak water chart to bear fire-fruit without first planting water-compatible causes. 3) Prefer practices whose causal logic matches the chart’s deficient phase (breath, diet, timing, virtue). 4) Treat ‘miraculous’ results that ignore seed-logic as unstable 邪道. 5) In life design, invest in early causal habits rather than late crisis rituals.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike Zhonghe’s focus on social-moral mid-balance, Benxiang emphasizes ontology of Dao–qi–form and explicit seed–fruit causality, with agricultural analogies. Unlike pure emptiness schools, it affirms real differentiation of natures; unlike later neidan Yinfu notes, it stays cosmological-causal rather than reverse-theft of cosmic energy."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "上方靈寶無極至道開化真經",
      "logic_thesis": "The Kaihua Zhenjing proves that the limitless Dao opens (開化) only through ordered human governance and virtue—ruler’s clarity, filial burial rites, moral education—so cosmic transformation and political–ethical order are one continuum. Ultimate Dao is not escape from the world but the successful civilizing of the world into Dao-resonance.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Ruler’s brightness is measured by whether the people are well governed with wide, kind policy. 2) Moral acts (burial with rite, prayer, good works) couple human sincerity to Heaven’s response. 3) Therefore ‘opening transformation’ is a feedback loop: virtue below → response above → further civilizing. 4) Unbounded (無極) Dao is accessed by finite, ranked human duties, not by antinomian transcendence. 5) Conclusion: political–familial ethics are themselves the ladder of cosmic initiation.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Map BaZi ‘officer/seal’ structures as capacity for ordered 開化, not merely status. 2) Use chart weak points as places requiring ethical-institutional repair (family duty, study, service). 3) Prefer cultivation that includes social virtue over pure cave isolation when the chart shows public-role qi. 4) Ritual timing should support civilizing ends (harmony, education), not only private gain. 5) Read disasters as failed 開化 feedback, then correct governance of self/household first.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike early Lingbao texts focused on otherworldly salvation and heavens, this Jin-dynasty Shangfang text fuses Confucian kingship ethics with Lingbao cosmology. It differs from Qingjing’s inward stillness path by insisting that Dao-opening is socio-political transformation, not only mind-emptying."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "太平兩同書",
      "logic_thesis": "Luo Yin’s Liangtong Shu proves that every social and cosmic polarity (noble/base, strong/weak, gain/loss, order/chaos, true/false) is co-arising: each side exists only by depending on its opposite, so ‘two same’ (兩同) is the real structure of peace. Therefore strategy and cultivation succeed by using the hidden interdependence of opposites, not by annihilating one pole.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Laozi’s ‘both arise from the same source but differ in name’ is taken as method. 2) Strength does not self-strengthen; it is served by weakness, and vice versa. 3) Gain and loss, respect and slight, order and chaos likewise co-define each other. 4) If opposites are co-constitutive, forcing pure one-sided victory destabilizes the whole. 5) Lasting 太平 arises only when both poles are held as one process. 6) Conclusion: dialectic of mutual dependence is the logic of governance and self-mastery.",
      "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi, treat clashes and combinations as 兩同 pairs: the clash is also the engine of movement. 2) When a chart is ‘too strong,’ deliberately employ the weak side (print, seal, or opposing phase) as stabilizer. 3) In luck analysis, expect gain years to seed loss and loss years to seed gain; plan for both. 4) Cultivation: do not kill desire by force alone; convert its energy via its opposite (stillness/activity). 5) Decision rule: any plan that requires absolute one-pole dominance is structurally unstable.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike pure Daoist quietism, Liangtong is a political-philosophical dialectic using Confucian–Daoist synthesis. Unlike Yinfu’s ‘theft’ model of energy competition, it emphasizes interdependence rather than stealth predation; unlike Zhonghe’s mid-point ethics, it stresses dynamic co-arising of extremes rather than simple averaging."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "洞玄靈寶左玄論",
      "logic_thesis": "The Zuoxuan Lun proves that Lingbao ‘left-mystery’ teaching works by emptying afflictive accumulations so that the body of merit becomes clear, pure, and spontaneously free—thus fusing Buddhist-style emptiness analysis with Daoist merit cosmology. Liberation is not accumulation of stuff but the removal of obscuring 惑累 until virtue’s native luminosity acts as teacher of the nine paths.",
      "logic_chain": "1) The Heavenly Worthy’s merit is great because afflictions are already gone. 2) Clarity and purity are definitions of that merit-body, not extra ornaments. 3) When bitter vexations cease, ‘constant joy and freedom’ appear as natural state. 4) Therefore commentary method is to dissolve attachments while preserving Lingbao soteriological ranks. 5) Hybrid Buddhist vocabulary is used as analytic tool for Daoist ends. 6) Conclusion: left-mystery path = purify by emptying, then merit shines as guidance.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Treat heavy BaZi ‘hurt officer / seven killings’ turmoil as 惑累 to empty, not merely to fight. 2) Practice: short daily release of mental narration before ritual or chart work. 3) Measure progress by reduction of compulsive reactivity, not by increase of spiritual thrills. 4) Combine precept merit (positive acts) with emptiness insight (non-clinging to the merit). 5) When reading classics, separate skillful analytic imports from core Daoist teleology.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike pure liturgical Lingbao, Zuoxuan is a scholastic commentary layer with strong Buddhist conceptual fusion. Unlike Qingjing’s brief mind-map to stillness, it elaborates merit-body ontology and multi-path teaching; unlike neidan Yinfu notes, it is soteriological-scholastic rather than reverse-alchemy of cosmic thieves."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "元始无量度人上品妙经注解",
      "logic_thesis": "Xue Jizhao’s annotation proves that the Duren Jing’s power lies in the classical structure of the text itself—names of heavens, demons, and the act of universal salvation—not in later internal-alchemy allegories. Correct reading restores ‘worldly-law’ and scriptural-intent efficacy: recitation and understanding of the original soteriological grammar open 度人, whereas over-neidanizing obscures the scripture’s public, cosmic rescue logic.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Duren’s core claim: the Primordial Heavenly Worthy’s scripture-words restructure cosmic ranks and save limitless beings. 2) Pre-Song notes largely serve this ‘世法’ reading. 3) Southern Song neidan readings remap the text onto the body-furnace. 4) Xue synthesizes earlier notes to recover plain scriptural sense. 5) If efficacy tracks correct sense, classical reading is not pedantry but method. 6) Conclusion: fidelity to original 度人 logic is the condition of real salvation-work.",
      "logic_practice": "1) When using Duren for fate-repair, prioritize correct recitation and ethical 度人 intent over forced sexual/alchemy codes. 2) Map chart disasters as ‘unrescued’ layers needing merit and name-power, not only element patches. 3) Study heaven/demon name lists as structural map of obstacles in a life, then address corresponding conduct. 4) Keep neidan as optional upper reading, not the only reading. 5) Measure results by reduction of communal and personal suffering, matching 无量度人.",
      "logic_compare": "Explicitly differs from Southern Song body-alchemy commentaries on the same scripture by returning to classical, non-neidan exegesis. Unlike pure ritual manuals, it is still interpretive synthesis; unlike Zhonghe, its axis is universal salvation grammar rather than mid-balance ethics."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "太上洞玄灵宝无量度人上品经法",
      "logic_thesis": "The Duren Jingfa proves that scripture becomes operative only when embedded in a complete 经法 system—ordination ranks, ritual sequence, visualization, and legal-spiritual protocol. The text’s limitless salvation is not automatic from reading alone; it is engineered through the method-body that couples human performance to the Primordial’s original 度人 act.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Duren claims cosmic rescue via sacred speech and presence. 2) Without ritual law, speech is mere literature. 3) 经法 supplies the coupling interface: altar, timing, ranks, mudras, petitions. 4) Correct method reenacts the original assembly in beginning-green heaven. 5) Therefore efficacy scales with fidelity of the method-system, not with private enthusiasm alone. 6) Conclusion: salvation is techno-ritual participation in the primordial event.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Pair chart remediation with structured liturgy (confession, offering, recitation order), not random mantra. 2) Align ritual timing with BaZi luck gates and calendar gods for coupling strength. 3) Use visualization of ten directions / heavens as cognitive map while correcting five-phase deficits. 4) Keep precept purity as pre-condition of 经法, matching Zhonghe’s moral physics. 5) After ritual, track concrete life changes as feedback on method integrity.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike Xue’s text-focused annotation, Jingfa is operational system-building. Unlike private Qingjing meditation, it is public-cosmic and hierarchical. Unlike Yinfu strategy texts, its power model is participatory reenactment of primordial salvation, not stealth theft of Heaven’s machine."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "黄帝阴符经解",
      "logic_thesis": "Jian Changchen’s Jie proves that the Yinfu’s essence is the human heart as cosmic trigger (机): by stilling and aligning that trigger with Heaven’s generative order, one ‘holds Heaven’s motion’ without needing elaborate inner-alchemy apparatus. Life-strategy succeeds when the mind’s mechanism is set to yin-yang timing rather than to restless self-will.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Heaven’s way is visible in five-phase ‘thefts’ and seasonal killing/generating. 2) Human nature is Heaven; human heart is the pivotal 机. 3) To stand Heaven’s way is to stabilize that pivot (often by stillness over motion). 4) En/harm reverse; birth/death inter-root—so timing knowledge outranks brute force. 5) Commentarial aim is cosmological life-nourishment, not full neidan scholasticism. 6) Conclusion: align heart-mechanism to Heaven’s schedule = entire art.",
      "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi, treat ‘useful god’ periods as Heaven’s 机 windows; act then, conserve otherwise. 2) Train daily stillness so the heart does not fire false killing-qi. 3) When chart shows strong ‘theft’ dynamics (peer/rob wealth), practice reverse-timing: take only in season. 4) Prefer quiet correction of desire over complex furnace maps for beginners. 5) Use en/harm reversal: what flatters may harm; what restrains may save.",
      "logic_compare": "Differs from full neidan Yinfu notes (e.g. later Quanzhen) by staying with Chen Tuan–style yin-yang cultivation and cosmic biochemistry rather than detailed elixir stages. Differs from pure military readings by making heart-stillness the command center of strategy."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "黄帝阴符经注解",
      "logic_thesis": "Ren Zhaoyi’s Zhujie proves that Yinfu is a compact map of mutual stealth among Heaven, Earth, things, and humans (三盗): whoever sees the mutual theft clearly can re-time intake and expenditure so the three powers rest. The argument is epistemic—insight into hidden exchanges reorders fate—more than ritual or moral preaching.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Heaven, things, and humans continuously steal from each other. 2) Disorder is mistimed or unseen theft; order is theft made ‘appropriate’ (盗机). 3) Seeing the five thieves and three thieves is therefore prosperity itself. 4) Annotation’s job is to make the hidden exchange graph legible. 5) Once legible, governance of body and state share one ledger. 6) Conclusion: clarity of cosmic accounting is the root technique.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Chart reading as theft-ledger: which phases steal from day-master, which can be reverse-stolen via luck. 2) Budget life-energy: sleep, sex, speech as expenditures against seasonal income. 3) In conflict years, reduce surface fighting; adjust timing of ‘taking.’ 4) Business/strategy: enter markets only when your phase is the seasonal thief, not the victim. 5) Cultivation: observe subtle leaks (worry, over-talk) as unauthorized 盗.",
      "logic_compare": "Compared with Jian’s heart-stillness emphasis, Ren’s note foregrounds the economic-ecological model of 三盗. Compared with Confucian moralizers of Yinfu, it is colder and more mechanical; compared with Wang Daoyuan’s verse-neidan, less poetic, more ledger-like."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "黄帝阴符经注",
      "logic_thesis": "This Song prose note proves that Yinfu’s three chapters (Dao–Fa–Shu) are a nested hierarchy: first unify with the one (抱一), then enrich the ‘state’ of the body-politic, then apply tactical victory—so technique without prior Dao is self-defeating. The logic forbids skipping levels: military or life tactics must hang from law, and law from the one Dao.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Upper chapter: hold the one and watch Heaven’s way. 2) Middle: only a settled interior ‘state’ can be rich and peaceful. 3) Lower: weapons and victories are last, timed applications. 4) If lower is used without upper, tactics become the fire that burns the wood. 5) Therefore annotation enforces vertical dependence of 术 on 法 on 道. 6) Conclusion: hierarchy of chapters is hierarchy of legitimate action.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Sequence BaZi work: first stabilize day-master (Dao), then resource flow (Fa), then competitive moves (Shu). 2) Reject ‘winning’ luck strategies that wreck health/foundation. 3) In cultivation, forbid advanced sexual/war metaphors until breath-mind is unified. 4) For career years high in killings, check whether 抱一 foundation exists before engaging. 5) After each victory cycle, return to stillness to prevent wood-fire self-burn.",
      "logic_compare": "Differs from flat single-principle notes by stressing chapter hierarchy as ethical-technical law. Differs from Sanhuang Yujue’s mythic secrecy by remaining scholastic-expository; differs from Zhu Xi–style Confucianizing by still treating Daoist body-state isomorphism seriously."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "黄帝阴符经注",
      "logic_thesis": "This second Song note proves that the same Yinfu sentences simultaneously code statecraft and body-governance: ‘country’ is body, ‘traitor’ is desire, ‘fire in wood’ is emotion consuming nature. The argument legitimates dual application without reducing the text to either pure politics or pure mysticism—one structure, two scales.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Classic images (fire/wood, traitor/state) are isomorphic templates. 2) Macro: untimely force ruins the polity. 3) Micro: untimely passion ruins the person. 4) Therefore one annotation can teach minister and adept at once. 5) The reader’s task is scalar translation, not choosing one exclusive sense. 6) Conclusion: Yinfu is a scale-invariant systems manual.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Translate chart ‘war’ symbols into both external conflict risk and internal emotion risk. 2) When seven-killings are strong, police desire first, then external enemies. 3) Use the same timing rules for medical regimen and strategic negotiation. 4) Journal daily: where did ‘fire born in wood’ appear as speech or lust? 5) Train dual reading of classics to avoid one-sided fanaticism.",
      "logic_compare": "Compared with purely neidan notes, it keeps political intelligence alive; compared with pure military Yinfu, it refuses to drop body-cultivation. It differs from Liangtong’s abstract dialectic by staying inside Yinfu’s concrete metaphor machine."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "黄帝阴符经解义",
      "logic_thesis": "Xiao Zhenzai’s Jieyi proves that Yinfu’s difficulty is semantic compression: each phrase packs cosmology, mind, and method, so ‘unpacking meaning’ (解义) is itself the practice. Correct exegesis dissolves contradictory folk readings and restores a coherent chain from watching Heaven to executing timely action.",
      "logic_chain": "1) The scripture is short because it is dense, not because it is thin. 2) Misreading multiplies because readers project army, alchemy, or Confucian ethics alone. 3) Systematic 解义 orders levels of sense without erasing any necessary level. 4) Once meaning-structure is clear, practice steps become selectable without superstition. 5) Thus philology is soteriology. 6) Conclusion: understanding the argument-form is half of ‘holding Heaven’s motion.’",
      "logic_practice": "1) Before applying any Yinfu line to a chart, write its cosmic, mental, and tactical senses. 2) Reject applications that only match one sense and contradict others. 3) Teach students a three-layer glossary (天/心/事) for each key term (贼, 盗, 机). 4) Use close reading as meditation: one sentence per sitting until inference is clean. 5) Audit your BaZi advice for hidden category errors (mixing 术 with 道).",
      "logic_compare": "More hermeneutical than Jian’s life-nourishment focus and more structured than raw visionary notes. Differs from 夹颂 verse-commentaries by remaining discursive prose unpacking; differs from Sanhuang Yujue by public scholastic clarity rather than sealed imperial myth."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "阴符经三皇玉诀",
      "logic_thesis": "The Sanhuang Yujue proves that Yinfu is an imperial-esoteric transmission of the Three Sovereigns: its ‘jade secrets’ claim that true 阴符 is a restricted operative key for commanding yin-yang mechanisms, not open philosophy. Authority of practice derives from mythic sovereign lineage and sealed instruction, which concentrates efficacy by limiting and sacralizing access.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Three Sovereigns archetype = origin of pattern-writing and cosmic governance. 2) Yinfu is framed as their jade instruction, not mere essay. 3) Therefore correct use requires transmission mind-set: reverence, secrecy, precise timing. 4) Open cleverness without seal-logic dilutes 机. 5) Operative commands (talismanic/temporal) rest on that sacral hierarchy. 6) Conclusion: efficacy is lineage-coupled technique, not free-floating theory.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Treat major fate-altering rites as requiring precondition (precepts, purity, correct calendar), not DIY cleverness. 2) In BaZi, mark ‘sovereign’ structures (strong seal/officer with dao) as capacity for lawful command of 机. 3) Prefer fewer, higher-integrity operations over constant tinkering. 4) Keep oral/manual keys distinct from public text reading. 5) After operation, observe whether results match lawful timing; if not, recheck transmission conditions.",
      "logic_compare": "Differs sharply from Song philosophical notes by sacralizing secrecy and sovereign lineage. Differs from Quanzhen popularizing verse notes by restricting rather than democratizing; differs from Duren’s universal salvation ethos by elite-operative framing of power."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "黄帝阴符经注",
      "logic_thesis": "This later Daoist note proves that Yinfu is a root classic of reverse cultivation: humans are stolen from by Heaven’s processes, yet can reverse-steal vitality by matching time, phase, and intention. The argument relocates immortality technique inside the same competitive ecology that produces ordinary aging and death.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Ordinary life is net loss under unnoticed cosmic theft. 2) Seeing the thieves converts loss into strategic exchange. 3) Neidan vocabulary maps ‘kill mechanism,’ ‘three thieves,’ and ‘five thieves’ onto essence-qi-spirit cycles. 4) Timing (食其时) is the hinge of reverse profit. 5) Therefore longevity is ecological intelligence, not defiance of nature. 6) Conclusion: immortal art = lawful reverse-theft within Heaven’s own rules.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Identify which natal phases are chronically ‘stolen’ (leaked) and seal them by lifestyle. 2) Practice seasonal reverse-taking: rest in strong killing seasons, gather in generating seasons. 3) Align sexual/energetic expenditure with chart’s true wealth of essence. 4) Use luck pillars as authorized ‘eating time,’ not as gambling chips. 5) Monitor aging markers as theft metrics; adjust practice when leak rises.",
      "logic_compare": "More explicitly neidan than Jian Changchen’s note; more embodied than purely political annotations. Differs from Qingjing’s pure stillness path by accepting competitive 盗 language as useful; differs from Sanhuang secrecy by teaching reverse-theft as learnable pattern rather than only sealed command."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "黄帝阴符经夹颂解注",
      "logic_thesis": "Wang Daoyuan’s jiasong commentary proves that Yinfu’s logic is best driven into the adept by dual channels—prose analysis plus verse fixation—so understanding and mnemonic-energetic imprint occur together. The form itself argues that realization needs both discursive clarity and condensed poetic seal upon the mind.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Dense classics are forgotten or distorted if only explained. 2) Verses compress meaning into chantable, memorable cores. 3) Prose prevents verse from becoming empty song. 4) Alternation creates a teaching loop: grasp → seal → re-grasp. 5) Quanzhen-style practice favors such interiorization. 6) Conclusion: dual-form commentary is a technology of embodiment, not decoration.",
      "logic_practice": "1) For each Yinfu line used in fate-work, write one plain inference and one short verse to recite. 2) Recite the verse in seasonal meditation matched to the chart’s useful phase. 3) Teach students to correct practice when verse and life diverge. 4) Use 夹颂 method on BaZi principles themselves (e.g. verse for ‘do not stack the strong’). 5) Prefer brief daily imprint over rare long lectures.",
      "logic_compare": "Differs from pure prose Song notes by adding systematic gatha seals; differs from bare scripture chant by retaining explanatory prose. Compared with Du Guangting’s Qingjing prose, it is more neidan-Quanzhen in flavor and more explicitly dual-channel pedagogic."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "太上老君说常清静经注",
      "logic_thesis": "Du Guangting’s note proves that constant clarity-stillness is not a mood but the operational mode of yuan-qi: ‘clear’ names original qi’s purity, ‘still’ its settled state, and the scripture is the path that lets the mind return to that mode so all later techniques become possible. The argument makes mind-governance the root law beneath ritual and alchemy.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Dao is formless, emotionless, nameless yet productive. 2) Human chaos arises from attaching names, desires, and motions to the mind. 3) Clearing and stilling reverse the cascade of delusion. 4) Du maps this with yuan-qi theory and double-negation (empty both being and empty-clinging). 5) Therefore precepts and practices serve the recovery of clear-still qi. 6) Conclusion: constant 清静 is the master key of cultivation.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Before BaZi judgment, sit until reactive labeling quiets—reduce projection onto the chart. 2) Daily: short cycles of ‘look at desire → desire empty → emptiness also not grasped.’ 3) Treat emotional storms in luck years as failures of 清静 first, elemental second. 4) Use clear-still state as precondition for talisman/ritual work. 5) Score progress by baseline mental noise, not by visions.",
      "logic_compare": "Earlier and more scholastic than Jin 颂注 versions; uses Tang chongxuan-style double emptying plus yuan-qi, not only poetic neidan. Differs from Yinfu’s competitive 盗 model by emphasizing non-contention stillness as power; differs from Zhonghe’s social ethics by locating the hinge primarily in mind-qi."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "太上老君说常清静经颂注",
      "logic_thesis": "The song-commentary proves that Qingjing realization must be both explained and sung into the heart: each prose gloss is sealed by a gatha so the adept does not cling to ‘empty’ as a new object nor to ‘still’ as dead quiet. The form argues for middle-path mind training—neither grasping form nor grasping emptiness—through rhythmic interiorization.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Qingjing text warns against dual diseases: dull empty and busy existence. 2) Prose alone may intellectualize the warning. 3) Gathas install the warning as living orientation. 4) Repeated song re-patterns attention under stress. 5) Thus 颂注 is practice infrastructure. 6) Conclusion: realization is stabilized when insight has a recitable body.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Memorize one gatha per major Qingjing sentence; use under emotional trigger. 2) In chart counseling, pause and silently run a clear-still verse before speaking remedy. 3) Alternate study day (prose) and embodiment day (song/breath). 4) Check clinging: if proud of ‘emptiness,’ apply the gatha that negates empty-clinging. 5) Pair with sleep and breath regularity so song rides on settled qi.",
      "logic_compare": "Differs from Du Guangting’s continuous prose by pedagogical verse sealing and often more Quanzhen-flavored interior alchemy. Differs from Wang’s Yinfu 夹颂 by targeting pure mind-clarity rather than cosmic theft strategy; more portable for daily mental first-aid than long Lingbao liturgies."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "元始天尊說生天得道經",
      "logic_thesis": "The Shengtian Dedao Jing proves that ‘birth in heaven and attainment of Dao’ share one staircase: fasting/precept purity, inward viewing, and regulated breath open the subtle body so the spirit can ascend. The argument unifies postmortem celestial birth and living realization as degrees of the same purification physics.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Primordial Worthy declares all perfected ones train from this path. 2) Precepts and purity are the bridge, not optional ethics. 3) Inward illumination of body-mind reveals the essential method. 4) Breath and attention refine the coarse into the subtle. 5) Subtlety is what can ‘birth’ into higher heavens or merge Dao. 6) Conclusion: ascent is engineered purification, not petition alone.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Use fasting periods and precept resets at major luck turns. 2) Daily neiguan: scan body for turbidity corresponding to chart’s heavy earth/damp or fire/agitation. 3) Breath counting as phase-balancer for scattered charts. 4) For ancestral/postmortem work, combine this purity logic with offerings—inner and outer. 5) Track dreams and mental light as feedback of 生天 progress without clinging.",
      "logic_compare": "More compact and practice-core than expansive Duren cosmology; less socio-political than Kaihua Zhenjing. Differs from Qingjing by adding explicit ascent/birth-in-heaven soteriology and breath-body steps; differs from Four Saints scripture by self-cultivation rather than martial exorcistic invocation."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "太上九天延祥滌厄四聖妙經",
      "logic_thesis": "The Four Saints scripture proves that many misfortunes are not only elemental imbalance but invasive disorder (demons, perverse qi, calamity nodes) that require invoking the Northern martial sanctities—Tianpeng, Tianyou, Yisheng, Zhenwu—whose function is to bind evil and extend auspiciousness. The logic is apotropaic: attentive invocation couples human crisis to a specialized celestial police force.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Beings suffer because greed, deceit, and impurity attract affliction. 2) Ordinary virtue may be insufficient once perverse forces are active. 3) Four Northern Saints command troops that specifically dissolve disasters. 4) Recitation, orientation north, and focused mindfulness trigger descent. 5) Thus scripture is an emergency protocol plus ethical warning. 6) Conclusion: 滌厄 is joint work of repentance and martial-spiritual intervention.",
      "logic_practice": "1) When BaZi shows stacked killings, voids, or repeated calamity gods, add Four Saints recitation cycles, not only five-phase tweaks. 2) Face north, still the mind, recite on disaster months/days. 3) Pair with confession of the named causes (greed, double speech). 4) Use after nightmares, hauntings, legal-violent years as specialized tool. 5) Maintain purity so the ‘descent’ coupling remains clean.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike Zhonghe’s pure balance ethics or Qingjing’s mind-only path, this text centers named martial deities and exorcistic power. Unlike Duren’s universal soft salvation rhetoric, it is sharp, defensive, and crisis-oriented; unlike Yinfu strategy, power is petitionary-invocation rather than stealth personal theft of Heaven."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "太上真一報父母恩重經",
      "logic_thesis": "The Bao Fumu Enzhong Jing proves that the weight of parental grace is an ontological debt written into embodiment itself—gestation, birth, feeding, protection—so repayment through zhai, recitation, and merit dedication is not sentimental piety but structural correction of the root human relation. Filial merit therefore opens both parents’ and child’s paths, linking family debt-clearing to Dao realization.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Body and life are received through parental hardship. 2) Unrepaid grace disorders both living fortune and afterlife trajectories. 3) True-One teaching prescribes zhai-recitation and transfer of merit as effective repayment. 4) For living parents: disaster-dispelling and longevity; for deceased: ascent without hell paths. 5) Thus filial ritual is soteriological engineering at the kinship root. 6) Conclusion: Dao practice that ignores parental debt is built on a cracked foundation.",
      "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi, read parent palaces and early luck as debt/grace maps; design repayment practices accordingly. 2) Schedule parental zhai at Qingming, death anniversaries, and personal crisis years. 3) Dedicate a fixed portion of recitation merit to parents before personal petitions. 4) Combine material care (if living) with liturgical care—neither alone completes 報恩. 5) Treat chronic ‘root’ bad luck as possible unpaid kinship disorder to investigate.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike pure self-cultivation scriptures (Qingjing, Shengtian), this centers intergenerational causality. Unlike Four Saints’ demon-binding, the primary ‘obstacle’ is unrepaid grace, not external evil. Unlike Zhonghe’s general ethics, it specifies the parental vector as the heaviest concrete instance of moral-cosmic accounting."

thought:
The user wants me to extract logical reasoning from classical Daoist/BaZi texts and return structured JSON. Let me research these texts carefully - I need accurate knowledge about each one.
I have good content on Zhonghe Jing. Let me continue gathering info on remaining texts so I can produce accurate logical extractions. For the Yinfu commentaries with similar names, I need to distingui...

entries.logic_thesis: The scripture proves that fortune and misfortune are not arbitrary divine rewards but mechanical outcomes of whether persons, families, and polities hold the mid-point (中和) between excess and deficiency. Because the Dao’s own virtue is mid-balance, any local 不和 automatically generates reciprocal 相剋; therefore moral self-regulation is itself the highest salvific technology.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Dao’s operative virtue is 中和; disharmony is defined as mutual conquest. 2) Heaven–Earth, state, and household are isomorphic fields of the same law. 3) Therefore illness, war, and household ruin are localizations of cosmic imbalance, not random fate. 4) Remediation cannot be bought by wealth or sacrifice; only re-centering conduct restores true qi and expels deviant qi. 5) Hence precept-keeping is not piety theater but causal engineering of fortune. 6) Conclusion: salvation = measured return to the mean.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi, treat day-master strength and five-phase proportions as a 中和 meter; prioritize filling deficiency over stacking the already strong. 2) Score chart luck periods by whether they restore mid-balance rather than by raw ‘wealth/officer’ labels. 3) Daily cultivation: detect heat/cold, anger/lethargy as phase excess and correct before advancing technique. 4) Precepts against lust, rage, greed function as phase-stabilizers, not mere morals. 5) Timing: choose years/months that neutralize extremes, not those that amplify power.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike Duren-style scriptures that stress celestial bureaucracy and ritual merit, Zhonghe locates causality inside measurable balance of qi and conduct. It is closer to Confucian Zhongyong ethics than to pure Lingbao liturgy, and unlike Yinfu’s stealth ‘theft of Heaven,’ it makes the open mean itself the law of fortune.

entries.logic_thesis: The Benxiang Jing proves that ‘naturalness’ (自然) is not blank spontaneity but the mature fruit of causal conditioning (因緣): different Dao-natures emit different qi, and different qi solidify into different forms. Therefore destiny patterns and agricultural/cosmic yields obey the same seed–fruit logic; to change a result one must change the prior causal seed, not merely wish for another fruit.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Dao differentiates; differentiation is mediated by qi. 2) Qi type determines material and mental nature (道性→物性). 3) What appears as ‘natural outcome’ is therefore the ripened form of prior causes. 4) If fruit follows seed, moral, ritual, and technical causes are not optional décor but ontological inputs. 5) Hence false paths and true paths can be discriminated by their seed-structure, not by temporary worldly success. 6) Conclusion: cultivation and fate-work are agriculture of causes.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Read a BaZi chart as a seed-field: natal stems/branches are initial conditions, luck cycles are seasonal weather. 2) Do not expect a weak water chart to bear fire-fruit without first planting water-compatible causes. 3) Prefer practices whose causal logic matches the chart’s deficient phase (breath, diet, timing, virtue). 4) Treat ‘miraculous’ results that ignore seed-logic as unstable 邪道. 5) In life design, invest in early causal habits rather than late crisis rituals.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike Zhonghe’s focus on social-moral mid-balance, Benxiang emphasizes ontology of Dao–qi–form and explicit seed–fruit causality, with agricultural analogies. Unlike pure emptiness schools, it affirms real differentiation of natures; unlike later neidan Yinfu notes, it stays cosmological-causal rather than reverse-theft of cosmic energy.

entries.name_han: 上方靈寶無極至道開化真經
entries.logic_thesis: The Kaihua Zhenjing proves that the limitless Dao opens (開化) only through ordered human governance and virtue—ruler’s clarity, filial burial rites, moral education—so cosmic transformation and political–ethical order are one continuum. Ultimate Dao is not escape from the world but the successful civilizing of the world into Dao-resonance.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Ruler’s brightness is measured by whether the people are well governed with wide, kind policy. 2) Moral acts (burial with rite, prayer, good works) couple human sincerity to Heaven’s response. 3) Therefore ‘opening transformation’ is a feedback loop: virtue below → response above → further civilizing. 4) Unbounded (無極) Dao is accessed by finite, ranked human duties, not by antinomian transcendence. 5) Conclusion: political–familial ethics are themselves the ladder of cosmic initiation.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Map BaZi ‘officer/seal’ structures as capacity for ordered 開化, not merely status. 2) Use chart weak points as places requiring ethical-institutional repair (family duty, study, service). 3) Prefer cultivation that includes social virtue over pure cave isolation when the chart shows public-role qi. 4) Ritual timing should support civilizing ends (harmony, education), not only private gain. 5) Read disasters as failed 開化 feedback, then correct governance of self/household first.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike early Lingbao texts focused on otherworldly salvation and heavens, this Jin-dynasty Shangfang text fuses Confucian kingship ethics with Lingbao cosmology. It differs from Qingjing’s inward stillness path by insisting that Dao-opening is socio-political transformation, not only mind-emptying.

entries.logic_thesis: Luo Yin’s Liangtong Shu proves that every social and cosmic polarity (noble/base, strong/weak, gain/loss, order/chaos, true/false) is co-arising: each side exists only by depending on its opposite, so ‘two same’ (兩同) is the real structure of peace. Therefore strategy and cultivation succeed by using the hidden interdependence of opposites, not by annihilating one pole.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Laozi’s ‘both arise from the same source but differ in name’ is taken as method. 2) Strength does not self-strengthen; it is served by weakness, and vice versa. 3) Gain and loss, respect and slight, order and chaos likewise co-define each other. 4) If opposites are co-constitutive, forcing pure one-sided victory destabilizes the whole. 5) Lasting 太平 arises only when both poles are held as one process. 6) Conclusion: dialectic of mutual dependence is the logic of governance and self-mastery.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi, treat clashes and combinations as 兩同 pairs: the clash is also the engine of movement. 2) When a chart is ‘too strong,’ deliberately employ the weak side (print, seal, or opposing phase) as stabilizer. 3) In luck analysis, expect gain years to seed loss and loss years to seed gain; plan for both. 4) Cultivation: do not kill desire by force alone; convert its energy via its opposite (stillness/activity). 5) Decision rule: any plan that requires absolute one-pole dominance is structurally unstable.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike pure Daoist quietism, Liangtong is a political-philosophical dialectic using Confucian–Daoist synthesis. Unlike Yinfu’s ‘theft’ model of energy competition, it emphasizes interdependence rather than stealth predation; unlike Zhonghe’s mid-point ethics, it stresses dynamic co-arising of extremes rather than simple averaging.

entries.logic_thesis: The Zuoxuan Lun proves that Lingbao ‘left-mystery’ teaching works by emptying afflictive accumulations so that the body of merit becomes clear, pure, and spontaneously free—thus fusing Buddhist-style emptiness analysis with Daoist merit cosmology. Liberation is not accumulation of stuff but the removal of obscuring 惑累 until virtue’s native luminosity acts as teacher of the nine paths.
entries.logic_chain: 1) The Heavenly Worthy’s merit is great because afflictions are already gone. 2) Clarity and purity are definitions of that merit-body, not extra ornaments. 3) When bitter vexations cease, ‘constant joy and freedom’ appear as natural state. 4) Therefore commentary method is to dissolve attachments while preserving Lingbao soteriological ranks. 5) Hybrid Buddhist vocabulary is used as analytic tool for Daoist ends. 6) Conclusion: left-mystery path = purify by emptying, then merit shines as guidance.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Treat heavy BaZi ‘hurt officer / seven killings’ turmoil as 惑累 to empty, not merely to fight. 2) Practice: short daily release of mental narration before ritual or chart work. 3) Measure progress by reduction of compulsive reactivity, not by increase of spiritual thrills. 4) Combine precept merit (positive acts) with emptiness insight (non-clinging to the merit). 5) When reading classics, separate skillful analytic imports from core Daoist teleology.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike pure liturgical Lingbao, Zuoxuan is a scholastic commentary layer with strong Buddhist conceptual fusion. Unlike Qingjing’s brief mind-map to stillness, it elaborates merit-body ontology and multi-path teaching; unlike neidan Yinfu notes, it is soteriological-scholastic rather than reverse-alchemy of cosmic thieves.

entries.name_han: 元始无量度人上品妙经注解
entries.logic_thesis: Xue Jizhao’s annotation proves that the Duren Jing’s power lies in the classical structure of the text itself—names of heavens, demons, and the act of universal salvation—not in later internal-alchemy allegories. Correct reading restores ‘worldly-law’ and scriptural-intent efficacy: recitation and understanding of the original soteriological grammar open 度人, whereas over-neidanizing obscures the scripture’s public, cosmic rescue logic.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Duren’s core claim: the Primordial Heavenly Worthy’s scripture-words restructure cosmic ranks and save limitless beings. 2) Pre-Song notes largely serve this ‘世法’ reading. 3) Southern Song neidan readings remap the text onto the body-furnace. 4) Xue synthesizes earlier notes to recover plain scriptural sense. 5) If efficacy tracks correct sense, classical reading is not pedantry but method. 6) Conclusion: fidelity to original 度人 logic is the condition of real salvation-work.
entries.logic_practice: 1) When using Duren for fate-repair, prioritize correct recitation and ethical 度人 intent over forced sexual/alchemy codes. 2) Map chart disasters as ‘unrescued’ layers needing merit and name-power, not only element patches. 3) Study heaven/demon name lists as structural map of obstacles in a life, then address corresponding conduct. 4) Keep neidan as optional upper reading, not the only reading. 5) Measure results by reduction of communal and personal suffering, matching 无量度人.
entries.logic_compare: Explicitly differs from Southern Song body-alchemy commentaries on the same scripture by returning to classical, non-neidan exegesis. Unlike pure ritual manuals, it is still interpretive synthesis; unlike Zhonghe, its axis is universal salvation grammar rather than mid-balance ethics.

entries.name_han: 太上洞玄灵宝无量度人上品经法
entries.logic_thesis: The Duren Jingfa proves that scripture becomes operative only when embedded in a complete 经法 system—ordination ranks, ritual sequence, visualization, and legal-spiritual protocol. The text’s limitless salvation is not automatic from reading alone; it is engineered through the method-body that couples human performance to the Primordial’s original 度人 act.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Duren claims cosmic rescue via sacred speech and presence. 2) Without ritual law, speech is mere literature. 3) 经法 supplies the coupling interface: altar, timing, ranks, mudras, petitions. 4) Correct method reenacts the original assembly in beginning-green heaven. 5) Therefore efficacy scales with fidelity of the method-system, not with private enthusiasm alone. 6) Conclusion: salvation is techno-ritual participation in the primordial event.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Pair chart remediation with structured liturgy (confession, offering, recitation order), not random mantra. 2) Align ritual timing with BaZi luck gates and calendar gods for coupling strength. 3) Use visualization of ten directions / heavens as cognitive map while correcting five-phase deficits. 4) Keep precept purity as pre-condition of 经法, matching Zhonghe’s moral physics. 5) After ritual, track concrete life changes as feedback on method integrity.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike Xue’s text-focused annotation, Jingfa is operational system-building. Unlike private Qingjing meditation, it is public-cosmic and hierarchical. Unlike Yinfu strategy texts, its power model is participatory reenactment of primordial salvation, not stealth theft of Heaven’s machine.

entries.logic_thesis: Jian Changchen’s Jie proves that the Yinfu’s essence is the human heart as cosmic trigger (机): by stilling and aligning that trigger with Heaven’s generative order, one ‘holds Heaven’s motion’ without needing elaborate inner-alchemy apparatus. Life-strategy succeeds when the mind’s mechanism is set to yin-yang timing rather than to restless self-will.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Heaven’s way is visible in five-phase ‘thefts’ and seasonal killing/generating. 2) Human nature is Heaven; human heart is the pivotal 机. 3) To stand Heaven’s way is to stabilize that pivot (often by stillness over motion). 4) En/harm reverse; birth/death inter-root—so timing knowledge outranks brute force. 5) Commentarial aim is cosmological life-nourishment, not full neidan scholasticism. 6) Conclusion: align heart-mechanism to Heaven’s schedule = entire art.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi, treat ‘useful god’ periods as Heaven’s 机 windows; act then, conserve otherwise. 2) Train daily stillness so the heart does not fire false killing-qi. 3) When chart shows strong ‘theft’ dynamics (peer/rob wealth), practice reverse-timing: take only in season. 4) Prefer quiet correction of desire over complex furnace maps for beginners. 5) Use en/harm reversal: what flatters may harm; what restrains may save.
entries.logic_compare: Differs from full neidan Yinfu notes (e.g. later Quanzhen) by staying with Chen Tuan–style yin-yang cultivation and cosmic biochemistry rather than detailed elixir stages. Differs from pure military readings by making heart-stillness the command center of strategy.

entries.logic_thesis: Ren Zhaoyi’s Zhujie proves that Yinfu is a compact map of mutual stealth among Heaven, Earth, things, and humans (三盗): whoever sees the mutual theft clearly can re-time intake and expenditure so the three powers rest. The argument is epistemic—insight into hidden exchanges reorders fate—more than ritual or moral preaching.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Heaven, things, and humans continuously steal from each other. 2) Disorder is mistimed or unseen theft; order is theft made ‘appropriate’ (盗机). 3) Seeing the five thieves and three thieves is therefore prosperity itself. 4) Annotation’s job is to make the hidden exchange graph legible. 5) Once legible, governance of body and state share one ledger. 6) Conclusion: clarity of cosmic accounting is the root technique.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Chart reading as theft-ledger: which phases steal from day-master, which can be reverse-stolen via luck. 2) Budget life-energy: sleep, sex, speech as expenditures against seasonal income. 3) In conflict years, reduce surface fighting; adjust timing of ‘taking.’ 4) Business/strategy: enter markets only when your phase is the seasonal thief, not the victim. 5) Cultivation: observe subtle leaks (worry, over-talk) as unauthorized 盗.
entries.logic_compare: Compared with Jian’s heart-stillness emphasis, Ren’s note foregrounds the economic-ecological model of 三盗. Compared with Confucian moralizers of Yinfu, it is colder and more mechanical; compared with Wang Daoyuan’s verse-neidan, less poetic, more ledger-like.

entries.logic_thesis: This Song prose note proves that Yinfu’s three chapters (Dao–Fa–Shu) are a nested hierarchy: first unify with the one (抱一), then enrich the ‘state’ of the body-politic, then apply tactical victory—so technique without prior Dao is self-defeating. The logic forbids skipping levels: military or life tactics must hang from law, and law from the one Dao.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Upper chapter: hold the one and watch Heaven’s way. 2) Middle: only a settled interior ‘state’ can be rich and peaceful. 3) Lower: weapons and victories are last, timed applications. 4) If lower is used without upper, tactics become the fire that burns the wood. 5) Therefore annotation enforces vertical dependence of 术 on 法 on 道. 6) Conclusion: hierarchy of chapters is hierarchy of legitimate action.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Sequence BaZi work: first stabilize day-master (Dao), then resource flow (Fa), then competitive moves (Shu). 2) Reject ‘winning’ luck strategies that wreck health/foundation. 3) In cultivation, forbid advanced sexual/war metaphors until breath-mind is unified. 4) For career years high in killings, check whether 抱一 foundation exists before engaging. 5) After each victory cycle, return to stillness to prevent wood-fire self-burn.
entries.logic_compare: Differs from flat single-principle notes by stressing chapter hierarchy as ethical-technical law. Differs from Sanhuang Yujue’s mythic secrecy by remaining scholastic-expository; differs from Zhu Xi–style Confucianizing by still treating Daoist body-state isomorphism seriously.

entries.logic_thesis: This second Song note proves that the same Yinfu sentences simultaneously code statecraft and body-governance: ‘country’ is body, ‘traitor’ is desire, ‘fire in wood’ is emotion consuming nature. The argument legitimates dual application without reducing the text to either pure politics or pure mysticism—one structure, two scales.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Classic images (fire/wood, traitor/state) are isomorphic templates. 2) Macro: untimely force ruins the polity. 3) Micro: untimely passion ruins the person. 4) Therefore one annotation can teach minister and adept at once. 5) The reader’s task is scalar translation, not choosing one exclusive sense. 6) Conclusion: Yinfu is a scale-invariant systems manual.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Translate chart ‘war’ symbols into both external conflict risk and internal emotion risk. 2) When seven-killings are strong, police desire first, then external enemies. 3) Use the same timing rules for medical regimen and strategic negotiation. 4) Journal daily: where did ‘fire born in wood’ appear as speech or lust? 5) Train dual reading of classics to avoid one-sided fanaticism.
entries.logic_compare: Compared with purely neidan notes, it keeps political intelligence alive; compared with pure military Yinfu, it refuses to drop body-cultivation. It differs from Liangtong’s abstract dialectic by staying inside Yinfu’s concrete metaphor machine.

entries.logic_thesis: Xiao Zhenzai’s Jieyi proves that Yinfu’s difficulty is semantic compression: each phrase packs cosmology, mind, and method, so ‘unpacking meaning’ (解义) is itself the practice. Correct exegesis dissolves contradictory folk readings and restores a coherent chain from watching Heaven to executing timely action.
entries.logic_chain: 1) The scripture is short because it is dense, not because it is thin. 2) Misreading multiplies because readers project army, alchemy, or Confucian ethics alone. 3) Systematic 解义 orders levels of sense without erasing any necessary level. 4) Once meaning-structure is clear, practice steps become selectable without superstition. 5) Thus philology is soteriology. 6) Conclusion: understanding the argument-form is half of ‘holding Heaven’s motion.’
entries.logic_practice: 1) Before applying any Yinfu line to a chart, write its cosmic, mental, and tactical senses. 2) Reject applications that only match one sense and contradict others. 3) Teach students a three-layer glossary (天/心/事) for each key term (贼, 盗, 机). 4) Use close reading as meditation: one sentence per sitting until inference is clean. 5) Audit your BaZi advice for hidden category errors (mixing 术 with 道).
entries.logic_compare: More hermeneutical than Jian’s life-nourishment focus and more structured than raw visionary notes. Differs from 夹颂 verse-commentaries by remaining discursive prose unpacking; differs from Sanhuang Yujue by public scholastic clarity rather than sealed imperial myth.

entries.logic_thesis: The Sanhuang Yujue proves that Yinfu is an imperial-esoteric transmission of the Three Sovereigns: its ‘jade secrets’ claim that true 阴符 is a restricted operative key for commanding yin-yang mechanisms, not open philosophy. Authority of practice derives from mythic sovereign lineage and sealed instruction, which concentrates efficacy by limiting and sacralizing access.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Three Sovereigns archetype = origin of pattern-writing and cosmic governance. 2) Yinfu is framed as their jade instruction, not mere essay. 3) Therefore correct use requires transmission mind-set: reverence, secrecy, precise timing. 4) Open cleverness without seal-logic dilutes 机. 5) Operative commands (talismanic/temporal) rest on that sacral hierarchy. 6) Conclusion: efficacy is lineage-coupled technique, not free-floating theory.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Treat major fate-altering rites as requiring precondition (precepts, purity, correct calendar), not DIY cleverness. 2) In BaZi, mark ‘sovereign’ structures (strong seal/officer with dao) as capacity for lawful command of 机. 3) Prefer fewer, higher-integrity operations over constant tinkering. 4) Keep oral/manual keys distinct from public text reading. 5) After operation, observe whether results match lawful timing; if not, recheck transmission conditions.
entries.logic_compare: Differs sharply from Song philosophical notes by sacralizing secrecy and sovereign lineage. Differs from Quanzhen popularizing verse notes by restricting rather than democratizing; differs from Duren’s universal salvation ethos by elite-operative framing of power.

entries.logic_thesis: This later Daoist note proves that Yinfu is a root classic of reverse cultivation: humans are stolen from by Heaven’s processes, yet can reverse-steal vitality by matching time, phase, and intention. The argument relocates immortality technique inside the same competitive ecology that produces ordinary aging and death.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Ordinary life is net loss under unnoticed cosmic theft. 2) Seeing the thieves converts loss into strategic exchange. 3) Neidan vocabulary maps ‘kill mechanism,’ ‘three thieves,’ and ‘five thieves’ onto essence-qi-spirit cycles. 4) Timing (食其时) is the hinge of reverse profit. 5) Therefore longevity is ecological intelligence, not defiance of nature. 6) Conclusion: immortal art = lawful reverse-theft within Heaven’s own rules.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Identify which natal phases are chronically ‘stolen’ (leaked) and seal them by lifestyle. 2) Practice seasonal reverse-taking: rest in strong killing seasons, gather in generating seasons. 3) Align sexual/energetic expenditure with chart’s true wealth of essence. 4) Use luck pillars as authorized ‘eating time,’ not as gambling chips. 5) Monitor aging markers as theft metrics; adjust practice when leak rises.
entries.logic_compare: More explicitly neidan than Jian Changchen’s note; more embodied than purely political annotations. Differs from Qingjing’s pure stillness path by accepting competitive 盗 language as useful; differs from Sanhuang secrecy by teaching reverse-theft as learnable pattern rather than only sealed command.

entries.logic_thesis: Wang Daoyuan’s jiasong commentary proves that Yinfu’s logic is best driven into the adept by dual channels—prose analysis plus verse fixation—so understanding and mnemonic-energetic imprint occur together. The form itself argues that realization needs both discursive clarity and condensed poetic seal upon the mind.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Dense classics are forgotten or distorted if only explained. 2) Verses compress meaning into chantable, memorable cores. 3) Prose prevents verse from becoming empty song. 4) Alternation creates a teaching loop: grasp → seal → re-grasp. 5) Quanzhen-style practice favors such interiorization. 6) Conclusion: dual-form commentary is a technology of embodiment, not decoration.
entries.logic_practice: 1) For each Yinfu line used in fate-work, write one plain inference and one short verse to recite. 2) Recite the verse in seasonal meditation matched to the chart’s useful phase. 3) Teach students to correct practice when verse and life diverge. 4) Use 夹颂 method on BaZi principles themselves (e.g. verse for ‘do not stack the strong’). 5) Prefer brief daily imprint over rare long lectures.
entries.logic_compare: Differs from pure prose Song notes by adding systematic gatha seals; differs from bare scripture chant by retaining explanatory prose. Compared with Du Guangting’s Qingjing prose, it is more neidan-Quanzhen in flavor and more explicitly dual-channel pedagogic.

entries.name_han: 太上老君说常清静经注
entries.logic_thesis: Du Guangting’s note proves that constant clarity-stillness is not a mood but the operational mode of yuan-qi: ‘clear’ names original qi’s purity, ‘still’ its settled state, and the scripture is the path that lets the mind return to that mode so all later techniques become possible. The argument makes mind-governance the root law beneath ritual and alchemy.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Dao is formless, emotionless, nameless yet productive. 2) Human chaos arises from attaching names, desires, and motions to the mind. 3) Clearing and stilling reverse the cascade of delusion. 4) Du maps this with yuan-qi theory and double-negation (empty both being and empty-clinging). 5) Therefore precepts and practices serve the recovery of clear-still qi. 6) Conclusion: constant 清静 is the master key of cultivation.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Before BaZi judgment, sit until reactive labeling quiets—reduce projection onto the chart. 2) Daily: short cycles of ‘look at desire → desire empty → emptiness also not grasped.’ 3) Treat emotional storms in luck years as failures of 清静 first, elemental second. 4) Use clear-still state as precondition for talisman/ritual work. 5) Score progress by baseline mental noise, not by visions.
entries.logic_compare: Earlier and more scholastic than Jin 颂注 versions; uses Tang chongxuan-style double emptying plus yuan-qi, not only poetic neidan. Differs from Yinfu’s competitive 盗 model by emphasizing non-contention stillness as power; differs from Zhonghe’s social ethics by locating the hinge primarily in mind-qi.

entries.name_han: 太上老君说常清静经颂注
entries.logic_thesis: The song-commentary proves that Qingjing realization must be both explained and sung into the heart: each prose gloss is sealed by a gatha so the adept does not cling to ‘empty’ as a new object nor to ‘still’ as dead quiet. The form argues for middle-path mind training—neither grasping form nor grasping emptiness—through rhythmic interiorization.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Qingjing text warns against dual diseases: dull empty and busy existence. 2) Prose alone may intellectualize the warning. 3) Gathas install the warning as living orientation. 4) Repeated song re-patterns attention under stress. 5) Thus 颂注 is practice infrastructure. 6) Conclusion: realization is stabilized when insight has a recitable body.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Memorize one gatha per major Qingjing sentence; use under emotional trigger. 2) In chart counseling, pause and silently run a clear-still verse before speaking remedy. 3) Alternate study day (prose) and embodiment day (song/breath). 4) Check clinging: if proud of ‘emptiness,’ apply the gatha that negates empty-clinging. 5) Pair with sleep and breath regularity so song rides on settled qi.
entries.logic_compare: Differs from Du Guangting’s continuous prose by pedagogical verse sealing and often more Quanzhen-flavored interior alchemy. Differs from Wang’s Yinfu 夹颂 by targeting pure mind-clarity rather than cosmic theft strategy; more portable for daily mental first-aid than long Lingbao liturgies.

entries.name_han: 元始天尊說生天得道經
entries.logic_thesis: The Shengtian Dedao Jing proves that ‘birth in heaven and attainment of Dao’ share one staircase: fasting/precept purity, inward viewing, and regulated breath open the subtle body so the spirit can ascend. The argument unifies postmortem celestial birth and living realization as degrees of the same purification physics.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Primordial Worthy declares all perfected ones train from this path. 2) Precepts and purity are the bridge, not optional ethics. 3) Inward illumination of body-mind reveals the essential method. 4) Breath and attention refine the coarse into the subtle. 5) Subtlety is what can ‘birth’ into higher heavens or merge Dao. 6) Conclusion: ascent is engineered purification, not petition alone.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Use fasting periods and precept resets at major luck turns. 2) Daily neiguan: scan body for turbidity corresponding to chart’s heavy earth/damp or fire/agitation. 3) Breath counting as phase-balancer for scattered charts. 4) For ancestral/postmortem work, combine this purity logic with offerings—inner and outer. 5) Track dreams and mental light as feedback of 生天 progress without clinging.
entries.logic_compare: More compact and practice-core than expansive Duren cosmology; less socio-political than Kaihua Zhenjing. Differs from Qingjing by adding explicit ascent/birth-in-heaven soteriology and breath-body steps; differs from Four Saints scripture by self-cultivation rather than martial exorcistic invocation.

entries.name_han: 太上九天延祥滌厄四聖妙經
entries.logic_thesis: The Four Saints scripture proves that many misfortunes are not only elemental imbalance but invasive disorder (demons, perverse qi, calamity nodes) that require invoking the Northern martial sanctities—Tianpeng, Tianyou, Yisheng, Zhenwu—whose function is to bind evil and extend auspiciousness. The logic is apotropaic: attentive invocation couples human crisis to a specialized celestial police force.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Beings suffer because greed, deceit, and impurity attract affliction. 2) Ordinary virtue may be insufficient once perverse forces are active. 3) Four Northern Saints command troops that specifically dissolve disasters. 4) Recitation, orientation north, and focused mindfulness trigger descent. 5) Thus scripture is an emergency protocol plus ethical warning. 6) Conclusion: 滌厄 is joint work of repentance and martial-spiritual intervention.
entries.logic_practice: 1) When BaZi shows stacked killings, voids, or repeated calamity gods, add Four Saints recitation cycles, not only five-phase tweaks. 2) Face north, still the mind, recite on disaster months/days. 3) Pair with confession of the named causes (greed, double speech). 4) Use after nightmares, hauntings, legal-violent years as specialized tool. 5) Maintain purity so the ‘descent’ coupling remains clean.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike Zhonghe’s pure balance ethics or Qingjing’s mind-only path, this text centers named martial deities and exorcistic power. Unlike Duren’s universal soft salvation rhetoric, it is sharp, defensive, and crisis-oriented; unlike Yinfu strategy, power is petitionary-invocation rather than stealth personal theft of Heaven.

entries.name_han: 太上真一報父母恩重經
entries.logic_thesis: The Bao Fumu Enzhong Jing proves that the weight of parental grace is an ontological debt written into embodiment itself—gestation, birth, feeding, protection—so repayment through zhai, recitation, and merit dedication is not sentimental piety but structural correction of the root human relation. Filial merit therefore opens both parents’ and child’s paths, linking family debt-clearing to Dao realization.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Body and life are received through parental hardship. 2) Unrepaid grace disorders both living fortune and afterlife trajectories. 3) True-One teaching prescribes zhai-recitation and transfer of merit as effective repayment. 4) For living parents: disaster-dispelling and longevity; for deceased: ascent without hell paths. 5) Thus filial ritual is soteriological engineering at the kinship root. 6) Conclusion: Dao practice that ignores parental debt is built on a cracked foundation.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi, read parent palaces and early luck as debt/grace maps; design repayment practices accordingly. 2) Schedule parental zhai at Qingming, death anniversaries, and personal crisis years. 3) Dedicate a fixed portion of recitation merit to parents before personal petitions. 4) Combine material care (if living) with liturgical care—neither alone completes 報恩. 5) Treat chronic ‘root’ bad luck as possible unpaid kinship disorder to investigate.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike pure self-cultivation scriptures (Qingjing, Shengtian), this centers intergenerational causality. Unlike Four Saints’ demon-binding, the primary ‘obstacle’ is unrepaid grace, not external evil. Unlike Zhonghe’s general ethics, it specifies the parental vector as the heaviest concrete instance of moral-cosmic accounting.
